programs.title: The UnXplained
programs.desc: All over the world, there are places and objects that are thought to be cursed; many people avoid these locations and things, believing they will bring harm, while others think that curses are nothing more than superstition and folklore.

programs.title: The UnXplained
programs.desc: Whether the ancients had scientific knowledge lost to time; how and why they fashioned remarkable feats of engineering.

programs.title: The UnXplained
programs.desc: Throughout history, humans have buried their dead in caves or chambers, in pyramids or in some form of a tomb; ancient tombs were visual memorials for the dead; in China, a vast necropolis was constructed as a way to connect to the afterlife.

programs.title: The UnXplained
programs.desc: Dracula, Lycaon of Arcadia, the Beast of Gévaudan; these are the names of grotesque monsters who have reared their terrifying heads throughout history, unearthly creatures that thrived on human blood and flesh.

programs.title: The UnXplained
programs.desc: Millions of people around the world claim to have had an encounter with a creature unlike any recognized by mainstream science such as the Mothman, Chupacabra, and Mongolian Death Worm.

programs.title: The UnXplained
programs.desc: Throughout history, powerful nations around the world have enlisted spies to serve as unique tools of warfare; these secret agents are often tasked with infiltrating organizations, gathering sensitive information and even performing the act of assassination; the most successful spies are the ones whose secrets are only revealed years after their mission has ended, or sometimes, never at all.

programs.title: The UnXplained
programs.desc: Every year, people risk their lives to enter places the world has marked off-limits, and in most cases, no one fully understands why. From the psychological forces that compel climbers to press on through the Death Zone of Mount Everest, to a stretch of New Mexico wilderness where at least 15 people have vanished without a trace, to a remote island in the Indian Ocean where trespassers are killed on sight - what is it about the world's most dangerous places that makes them impossible to resist?

programs.title: The UnXplained
programs.desc: From demonic possession and cursed homes to battlefield apparitions and ancient pacts with the Devil, history is filled with chilling accounts of supernatural forces said to be working against humanity. Are these terrifying encounters simply the product of fear and belief... or could they point to a hidden war between good and evil-one that continues to this day?

programs.title: The UnXplained
programs.desc: During The Golden Age of Piracy, thousands of buccaneers terrorized the high seas and became legends; their exploits spawned stories of larger-than-life characters, billion dollar heists, and buried treasure that to this day, has never been found.

programs.title: The UnXplained
programs.sub_title: Strange Tales From the American Frontier
programs.desc: Bizarre, mysterious tales ran rampant and are still being told to this day; are these strange tales of the American frontier simply legend, or was the west far stranger than one could possibly imagine?
